source: Applicant pasted final local audit output in conversation; transcribed by Codex without changing reported values

codex_checks.scope: Summary arithmetic and schedule; not reexecution of audit_study on full original events/protocol

attribution.applicant: Direct practice/measurement execution and relayed audit summaries
attribution.codex: Prior environment and procedure guidance; code implementation; summary validation, documentation and commit

limits: One participant, same fixed data and repeated task; prior v1 and practice experience confound learning/order comparisons.
All measured attempts, including the A interruption, are included; practice is separate. Interrupt causes are not present in the summary.
Zero logged pause time does not independently prove absence of unlogged interruption or external help; these were not separately reported for v2.
Automated fill and reviewed confirmation do not independently establish equal review depth or understanding.
No original protocol, full events or source fingerprints received; PASS is the applicant-relayed local audit result.
Non-machine time includes input/review/waiting overhead; not measured focused labor.
No causal v1-versus-v2 speedup, general company productivity or independent full-project authorship claim.
independent_implementation: Separate user-selected full-project exercise; earlier applicant SQL/hand calculation/judgment remains complete. Measurement does not substitute for implementation.
